nodes.label: Actions-on-a-change fluid workflow
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.community_name: Proton Sync Change and Runtime Specs
nodes.rationale: Apply can run anytime tasks exist and may suggest artifact updates when implementation reveals design issues; not phase-locked.

nodes.label: Explore stance (thinking partner, no implementation)
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.community_name: Proton Sync Change and Runtime Specs
nodes.rationale: Explore is a stance not a workflow: curious, visual (ASCII diagrams), grounded in the codebase; may create OpenSpec artifacts but never application code, and never auto-captures decisions.

nodes.label: applyRequires artifact dependency order
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.community_name: Proton Sync Change and Runtime Specs
nodes.rationale: Artifacts (proposal, design, specs, tasks) are created in dependency order until every applyRequires artifact is done; context/rules from instructions are constraints, never copied into the artifact.

nodes.label: Intelligent merging of delta specs
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.community_name: Proton Sync Change and Runtime Specs
nodes.rationale: Agent-driven sync lets a delta express intent (e.g. add one scenario) without copying whole requirements; must be idempotent and preserve unmentioned content.
